parts.name: base body

physics.Basic_description: The main lower body of the stapler, appearing as a matte light grey/white plastic chassis with a rectangular profile.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural foundation for the stapler, housing the staple channel and supporting the anvil plate.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper can firmly grasp the sides of the base to stabilize the object during operation or transport.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic housing typical for office supplies, enclosing an empty channel for staples.

parts.description: The main lower body of the stapler, appearing as a matte light grey/white plastic chassis with a rectangular profile.
parts.function: Provides the structural foundation for the stapler, housing the staple channel and supporting the anvil plate.

parts.name: foot pad 0

physics.Basic_description: Small black rubber pads located on the underside of the base (inferred from standard design, though barely visible in mask).
physics.Functional_description: Prevents the stapler from sliding on the desk surface during use.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; too small and flat against the surface.
physics.reason: Small solid rubber components attached to the bottom.

parts.name: anvil plate

physics.Basic_description: A small, flat metallic plate embedded in the top surface of the base, appearing silver/grey.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a hard surface with grooves to bend the staple legs inward or outward after piercing paper.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to be grasped effectively; part of the functional interface.
physics.reason: Solid metal stamping required to withstand impact forces.

parts.description: A small, flat metallic plate embedded in the top surface of the base, appearing silver/grey.
parts.function: Provides a hard surface with grooves to bend the staple legs inward or outward after piercing paper.

parts.name: rear housing

physics.Basic_description: The rear vertical section of the base, colored slightly darker grey in the render, forming the back stop.
physics.Functional_description: Encloses the rear mechanism and provides structural integrity to the base assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped as part of the base, though less stable than the main body.
physics.reason: Molded plastic shell component, hollow interior.

parts.description: The rear vertical section of the base, colored slightly darker grey in the render, forming the back stop.
parts.function: Encloses the rear mechanism and provides structural integrity to the base assembly.

parts.name: arm shell

physics.Basic_description: The upper moving arm of the stapler, a long matte light grey/white plastic cover.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the spring mechanism and provides the lever arm for the user to press down to drive staples.
physics.Grasped_description: The primary interaction point; a gripper would grasp the top or sides of this arm to simulate stapling or open the device.
physics.reason: Thin-walled plastic cover over internal metal rails and springs.

parts.description: The upper moving arm of the stapler, a long matte light grey/white plastic cover.
parts.function: Houses the spring mechanism and provides the lever arm for the user to press down to drive staples.

parts.name: carrier rail

physics.Basic_description: Internal metal rail visible inside the arm when opened, appearing dark grey/metallic.
physics.Functional_description: Guides the staples and transfers force from the arm to the driver blade.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, not accessible for grasping during normal operation.
physics.reason: Stamped sheet metal channel, treated as solid for mass approximation relative to thin walls.

parts.description: Internal metal rail visible inside the arm when opened, appearing dark grey/metallic.
parts.function: Guides the staples and transfers force from the arm to the driver blade.

parts.name: driver blade

physics.Basic_description: Small metal protrusion at the front of the top arm, visible as a tiny cyan/metallic tip.
physics.Functional_description: Physically pushes the staple out of the magazine and through the paper.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and sharp to grasp; functional tip only.
physics.reason: Solid hardened steel component required for impact.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
